r3_note: From 11:13 to 1:00:30 the lesson is one long listening drill (Amal says a make-X / get-X verb, Medi glosses it in English), so D3-D27 are all mode=listening and stay apart. The two readers split systematically: r1 filed each misread as grammar with a bucket, r2 as vocab-A tier 1. READER-BRIEF says a form slip that a bucket rule names is grammar ("بسط for انبسط is GRAMMAR B12 not vocab"), so I ruled grammar wherever the misread piece is a form the buckets cover (B12 make/get, B1 b- present, B5 tense, B18 person prefix, D3/D4 endings, D1 preposition) and vocab only where the wrong piece is a different word or a word shape with no bucket (D1 nineteen, D2 dark). Names: Palestine, Spanish - never glossed. Engine notes: 38:59 'By all eight' = his بيتأسفوا; 42:47 he admits he heard منا for معنا; 32:24 'No.' is Medi's own line, not Amal's. Agreed rows A1-A10 all hold on the transcript - no challenges.

rows.medi_said: This is it today. تسعة عشرين. ... uh, تسعة عشر. ... تسعش or تسعش. ... تسعش ستة.
